reports.title: Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Updated Outlook for the Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2026
section: The Company will report 53 weeks of operating results in fiscal 2026 and provides the following guidance for fiscal 2026:
•Net sales of approximately $4,765 million to $4,835 million
◦The 53rd week is expected to contribute approximately $65 million to net sales
◦The 53rd week is expected to contribute approximately $0.08 to diluted EPS
◦The 53rd week is expected to contribute approximately $0.08 to Adjusted diluted EPS*
•Adjusted EBITDA* of approximately $535 million to $550 million
◦The 53rd week is expected to contribute approximately $11 million to Adjusted EBITDA*
•Depreciation and amortization expense of approximately $250 million
